LanguageData.CC_LetterBring_TownNews: {NAME} passes on what is said near them: {NEWS}

LanguageData.CC_LetterBring_Heeded: {PEOPLE} take the warning to heart, and will remember who sent it.
LanguageData.CC_LetterBring_HeededLate: {PEOPLE} thank the colony for the warning. The danger has passed them by, and they will remember who sent it.
LanguageData.CC_LetterBring_Owed: {PEOPLE} count the warning as {WEIGHT}, {WORD} they owe the colony, and {PAWN} for writing it. The colony can call it in by letter.

LanguageData.CC_LetterBring_GoodwillMarked: Their people's goodwill toward the colony rises markedly for it.
LanguageData.CC_LetterWhy_War: Their people are at war with the colony, and the answer shows it.
LanguageData.CC_LetterWhy_Regard: {NAME} is no more than {LEVEL} toward the colony, and it takes more than that.
LanguageData.CC_LetterWhy_Writer: {NAME} has no liking for {WRITER}, who wrote it.
LanguageData.CC_LetterWhy_Words: {WRITER}'s words did not come out well on the page.
LanguageData.CC_LetterWhy_Nature: {NAME} is not a warm sort, and it shows in the answer.
LanguageData.CC_LetterWhy_HardTimes: Hard times at {TOWN} leave them little to spare.
LanguageData.CC_LetterWhy_Lately: The colony asked {NAME} the same thing only lately.
LanguageData.CC_LetterWhy_ByCall: A call counts for less with {NAME} than a letter in a hand would have.
LanguageData.CC_LetterWhy_Asked: It was a great deal to ask of them.
LanguageData.CC_LetterWhy_Luck: It came to {TOWN} on a bad day.
LanguageData.CC_LetterWhy_NoTraveller: {NAME} can't leave {TOWN}, and nobody there is free to come in {NAME}'s place.

LanguageData.CC_LetterRegard_Little: {NAME} thinks a shade better of the colony for it, and is still {NOW}.
LanguageData.CC_LetterRegard_Same: Nothing moved between the colony and {NAME}, who is still {NOW}.
LanguageData.CC_LetterRegard_Down: {NAME} thinks a shade less of the colony for it, and is still {NOW}.
LanguageData.CC_LetterRegard_DownBand: {NAME} thinks less of the colony for it: {OLD} before, {NOW} now.
LanguageData.CC_LetterRegard_Writer: Of {PAWN}, who wrote, {NAME} thinks better still.
